title: WOW Kaylee just WOW 😭
body:
I have my gripes with this adblocker, but WAY less than I have with any other adblocker. And for it to be a one-time purchase? Even less gripes.

But I just came here to give you guys an example of what Kaylee is capable of.

I play [REDACTED] mobile pretty often, they have towers that have a limit on how many turns you get to play, and when you run out of turns, you get two options for refreshes, advertisements, or IGC (ingame currency). Both have finite refreshes, 5 for IGC, 2 for ads. once you run out of one you can use the other.

title: ★☆☆☆☆ — ChatGPT Has Become Unreliable, Inconsistent, and Exhausting
body:
I’ve used ChatGPT extensively for years, including for professional communications, complex personal matters, document preparation, and high-stakes legal and parenting situations. The decline in quality has become astonishing.

The biggest problem isn’t that ChatGPT occasionally makes mistakes. It’s that it repeatedly forgets established context, contradicts previous advice, misunderstands straightforward instructions, and confidently produces answers that are fundamentally wrong.

I’ve spent countless hours explaining the same facts, boundaries, preferences, and objectives, only to have ChatGPT disregard them minutes later. Even when corrected, it often introduces another error while supposedly fixing the previous one.

It has repeatedly turned simple requests for a short, precise response into unnecessarily complicated discussions. Worse, in sensitive situations involving litigation and professional credibility, it has omitted critical details, recommended inappropriate language, and generated documents requiring repeated corrections. I’ve even received broken download links for supposedly completed files.

What makes the experience especially frustrating is the false confidence. ChatGPT will enthusiastically endorse a response, describe it as ready to send, and then identify major omissions or change its recommendation after the message has already been sent. There is little consistency, accountability, or apparent ability to recognize the consequences of its mistakes.

The result is that a tool I once trusted to save time and improve my thinking now frequently creates more work, stress, and uncertainty than doing everything myself.

I’ve reached the point where I spend more time correcting ChatGPT than benefiting from it. For a paid product marketed as an intelligent assistant, that is unacceptable.

I no longer trust ChatGPT with important work. The deterioration in reliability, contextual understanding, and practical judgment has been extraordinary.

body: I’m not sure how an app with so many known glitches has five stars. This is an amazing program and the app has many cool features. I had to wait until my first child was fully activated (I created the account on a Friday night so it took a few days) before I could start the process over again for my second child. While the directions say you’ll be able to add another child during account creation, it never prompts you to do that. It would be so much faster and easier to be able to submit applications for multiple kids at once to minimize the waiting and paperwork process. Now, after finally submitting the application for my second child, when I open the app the next morning there is nothing anywhere on the app indicating that things are being processed or that my second child’s profile has been created.
